# ⚠️ AI-written code: please read

**Flipbook was written by an AI.** Every line of its code was generated by **Claude**, an AI model made by Anthropic, in conversation with Doug Craven.

This is sometimes called *vibe coding*. Doug designed the tool, decided what it should do, and tested every feature by hand in Moho. Claude wrote, debugged and revised the code. **No human programmer has reviewed the code line by line.**

## What that means for you

- **Save a backup of your .moho file before you use Flipbook on real work.** Flipbook writes keyframes, actions (saved poses and riffles) and key colours into your file.
- Ctrl+Z (undo) works for Flipbook's changes, but a backup is still the safe habit.
- The code has been tested in **Moho Pro 14.5 on Windows only.** Mac and other Moho versions are untested.
- Bugs are likely. If you find one, please open an issue on this repository and describe what you did and what happened.
